layouts.name: Badger Kart Club
layouts.description: Combined mapped configurations: Badger Classic Track, Badger National Track, Badger Bus-Stop Track. Shared sections count once in the mapped branch length. Branch identity and historical alignment still need review.

layouts.name: Badger Classic Track
layouts.description: The club published Classic diagram identifies the full inner esses, plain eastern return and short southern return; it excludes the National southern extension and the eastern Bus-Stop.

layouts.name: Badger National Track
layouts.description: The club published National diagram identifies the full inner esses, plain eastern return and complete southern hairpin extension; the diagonal southern shortcut is excluded.

layouts.name: Badger Bus-Stop Track
layouts.description: The club published Bus-Stop diagram identifies the full inner esses, eastern Bus-Stop and short southern return; it excludes the National extension and its diagonal shortcut.

sources.title: Aggregate layout identification
sources.evidenceNote: The general venue entry includes the club named Classic, National and Bus-Stop configurations. The three published route diagrams identify the inner esses, complete National southern hairpin and eastern Bus-Stop. Their independently mapped branch union is displayed as a network, not a lap; the unlisted diagonal shortcut and outer shortcut bypassing the esses are excluded. The unique branch distance of 1125.8 m is preserved separately from the catalogue 1186 m. Identification only; no image coordinates copied.
